svg.title: Blue Panel
svg.desc: Interpretive SVG study from the actual primary auction photograph. Approximate geometry, standardized vivid palette; photographic shadows, frame and texture omitted.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://www.sothebys.com/en/auctions/ecatalogue/2018/contemporary-art-evening-auction-n09858/lot.33.html; visually inspected2026-10-27; editable study, not a facsimile.
